title: Monitoring and Logging
summary: Observability practices for production systems, tracking key metrics and using specialized tools.

content.overview: Observability is critical for production systems, requiring collection of metrics, logs, and traces.
content.details: Metrics to track: request rate and latency, error rates, CPU and memory usage, database connection pool stats. Tools: Prometheus for metrics, Grafana for visualization, ELK stack for logs, Jaeger for distributed tracing.
